Only the host example.com is saved. Scheme, port, path, query and fragment are not routing conditions. HTTP/HTTPS only; credentials are rejected.

International names are normalized to browser-compatible ASCII/Punycode. The same exact/suffix rules apply.

No page-path matching, arbitrary * patterns, kw: keywords or re: regular expressions. One address per input; maximum 2,048 characters.
